briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Anthropic Claude 4.5 intensify multi-agent race as compute shortages bite.

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs push multi-agent systems amid regulatory scrutiny. Funding surges in inference infrastructure while safety gaps widen in production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced tool-use; Anthropic launched Claude 4.5 focusing on long-horizon reasoning. DeepSeek-V3 and xAI Grok-3 trail in benchmarks but close gap on cost-efficiency.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits delays; Microsoft and Google announce new 100k H100 clusters. TSMC reports AI chip demand up 67% YoY.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol standards like DialectForge be adopted industry-wide before the first major autonomous AI incident?
